chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from his brother al-Ḥusayn, from his father ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام about a man who recites in Salat al-Jumuʿah something other than Surat al-Jumuʿah deliberately. He said: There is no harm in that.

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلَ: a title referring to Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام
key_terms.سُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ: Surat al-Jumuʿah, the chapter usually associated with Friday prayer recitation
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite a surah other than Surat al-Jumuʿah in Salat al-Jumuʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the recitation in Salat al-Jumuʿah and states that if a person deliberately recites a surah other than Surat al-Jumuʿah, there is no problem in doing so. It indicates permissibility in this matter and serves as a legal ruling related to the performance of the Friday prayer.
